verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Elasticsearch API keys, role-based access control, or any mechanism for issuing scoped/least-privilege credentials to an AI agent; in fact, the MCP server probe explicitly notes the local-dev handshake ran with security disabled and no credentials required. This is an applicable axis for a data platform exposing an MCP server to agents, but no evidence shows a scoped-credential capability being delivered.
